rules.V03: onset = max(0.5, t_s + onset_offset_s); rejected when route_end_s - onset < 5 s, i.e. onset_offset_s must be <= latest_onset_offset_s_for_V03 (null row = event not detected on that baseline = rejected); events_gradable_at_kmh lists the probed speeds with room for some allowed offset
rules.friction_demand: v2kappa_mps2 = speed^2 * |kappa| is the nominal lateral demand; the P-02 limit is 4.41 * tire_friction_scale m/s^2. DF-06 friction_utilization = v2kappa / (0.9 * tire_friction_scale * 9.81): near 1 the tyres are close to the grip limit and LQR has little margin left to recover; v2kappa above the P-02 limit only tags stress_test
rules.speed: speed_mps is the baseline speed at the event (the car may be slower than max_speed_kmh in curves); it scales roughly with max_speed_kmh, the event times shift with speed
